_comment: Score cutoffs for the PEDDEP graded ChIP-seq QC report, carried over from the PEDDEP/SEAseq evaluation-statistics.pl report. 'higher': value >= cutoffs[i] earns -1, 0, +1, +2 (below the first cutoff = -2). 'status': FastQC-style pass = +2, warn = 0, fail = -2. NSC, RSC, FRiP, Total_Peaks and ROSE counts are not graded for Input/IgG controls. Metrics not listed are reported but not graded.
